title.narrative: Appraisal of the Danish contribution to International Institute of Sustainable development, IISD

description.narrative: The purpose of the appraisal is to conduct a final quality assurance of the project documentation for the Danish support to the IISD, with a view to enable finalisation of a project document which is ready for approval. The appraisal should assess the relevance, quality and feasibility of the project design and documentation, including whether they are fit to underpin project implementation and produce the expected results effectively, efficiently and sustainably. The appraisal should assess the alignment to the Danish Strategy for Development Cooperation and the Danida Aid Management Guidelines. The appraisal should provide concrete and solution-oriented recommendations for adjustments as needed, which will guide the finalization of the project document for the proposed support ahead of approval
